expected_level_description: You can: - manage service components to ensure they meet business needs and key performance indicators (KPIs)

You can: - analyse current processes - identify and implement opportunities to optimise processes - lead and develop a team of experts to deliver service improvements - help to evaluate and establish requirements for the implementation of changes by setting policy and standards

You can: - design, review and quality assure solutions and services, ensuring that they are specifically engineered to mitigate security threats - lead others in using appropriate information security practices
You can: - identify and apply modern development standards to support complex projects and programmes - lead others in applying modern development standards

You can: - advise on the right way to apply standards and methods to ensure compliance - maintain technical responsibility for all the stages and iterations of a software development project - provide technical advice to stakeholders and set the team-based standards for programming tools and techniques
You can: - use a variety of prototyping methods - share best practice and coach others - look at strategic service design end to end
You can: - identify, locate and fix service faults

You can: - design systems characterised by high levels of risk, impact, and business or technical complexity - control system design practice within an enterprise or industry architecture - influence industry-based models for the development of new technology applications - develop effective implementation and procurement strategies, consistent with business needs - ensure adherence to relevant technical strategies, policies, standards and practices
You can: - define the integration build - co-ordinate build activities across systems - understand how to undertake and support integration testing activities

You can: - collaborate with user researchers and can represent users internally - explain the difference between user needs and the desires of the user - champion user research to focus on all users - prioritise and define approaches to understand the user story, guiding others in doing so - offer recommendations on the best tools and methods to use

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload

You can: - lead hazard identification and risk assessment for a product or change - write and maintain hazard logs and clinical safety case reports - agree risk controls with product teams and check that they work - advise teams on applying clinical risk management standards

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
You can: - set interoperability standards and strategy for the organisation - lead national or cross-organisation standards work - assure the design of critical integrations across many systems
You can: - follow a software life cycle process that meets medical device standards - produce the records that such a process requires
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
